name: Build Rais Thu Chi (Release APK + AAB)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - '*.zip'
      - '.github/workflows/build-rais-release.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      ANDROID_HOME: /usr/local/lib/android/sdk
      ANDROID_SDK_ROOT: /usr/local/lib/android/sdk
      HAS_RELEASE_KEY: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64 != '' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
          cache: gradle

      - name: Install Android SDK packages
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          SDKMANAGER="$(find "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools" -type f -name sdkmanager -print -quit)"
          if [[ -z "$SDKMANAGER" ]]; then
            echo "sdkmanager not found at $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools"
            exit 1
          fi
          yes | "$SDKMANAGER" --licenses >/dev/null || true
          "$SDKMANAGER" "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0"

      - name: Install Gradle 8.7
        run: |
          wget -q https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.7-bin.zip -O "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip"
          unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-8.7/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Find and extract project ZIP
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ZIP_NAME=""
          while IFS= read -r f; do
            if unzip -Z1 "$f" | grep -Eq '(^|/)settings\.gradle(\.kts)?$'; then ZIP_NAME="$f"; fi
          done < <(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -iname '*.zip' -printf '%f\n' | sort)
          [[ -n "$ZIP_NAME" ]] || { echo "Không tìm thấy ZIP dự án Android ở thư mục gốc."; exit 1; }
          echo "Build project: $ZIP_NAME"
          mkdir extracted rais-project
          unzip -q "$ZIP_NAME" -d extracted
          if [[ -f extracted/settings.gradle || -f extracted/settings.gradle.kts ]]; then
            cp -a extracted/. rais-project/
          else
            SETTINGS="$(find extracted -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name settings.gradle -o -name settings.gradle.kts \) -print -quit)"
            [[ -n "$SETTINGS" ]] || { echo "ZIP thiếu settings.gradle"; exit 1; }
            cp -a "$(dirname "$SETTINGS")"/. rais-project/
          fi
          test -f rais-project/app/build.gradle -o -f rais-project/app/build.gradle.kts

      - name: Require permanent release signing key
        if: env.HAS_RELEASE_KEY != 'true'
        run: |
          echo "Thiếu GitHub Secret RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64. Không tạo bản release giả/không thể cập nhật; hãy cấu hình đủ 4 secrets theo README."
          exit 1

      - name: Configure release signing key
        env:
          KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEY_ALIAS }}
          KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.RAIS_KEY_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "$KEYSTORE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rais-release.jks"
          echo "RAIS_KEYSTORE_FILE=$RUNNER_TEMP/rais-release.jks" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD=$KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEY_ALIAS=$KEY_ALIAS" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "RAIS_KEY_PASSWORD=$KEY_PASSWORD" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Build signed release APK and AAB
        working-directory: rais-project
        run: gradle clean assembleRelease bundleRelease --stacktrace

      - name: Verify build outputs
        working-directory: rais-project
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          find app/build/outputs -type f \( -name '*.apk' -o -name '*.aab' \) -print
          test -f app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
          test -f app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab

      - name: Upload APK and AAB
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Rais-ThuChi-SIGNED-RELEASE
          path: |
            rais-project/app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk
            rais-project/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/*.aab
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
